summary: Three orange lights in a line over the fields for about four minutes then they went out one at a time.
Wood knocks across the creek after dark and a smell like a wet dog. Dog would not leave the porch.
Silent black triangle moving slow over the lake with a red light at each corner.
Something large and upright crossed the logging road and the truck stalled.
Bright white orb low over the tobacco barns then shot straight up.
